title: Ancient Mother
about: A slow, keening invocation — “Ancient Mother, I hear you calling” — sung traditional, and carried far by Robert Gass and On Wings of Song’s 1993 recording; it has since entered the hymnals (Singing the Journey #1069). It is printed in Rainbow AU songs, vol. A, p.5, song #26. The melody here follows the singing on Mettaben’s Rainbow Chant Collection — ancient_mother.mp3 (CC BY-NC-SA).
melody_note: Transcribed by song2xml from Mettaben's ancient_mother.mp3 (90s clip, no separation). 35.5% words fit — low because the chant is slow and melismatic; phrase detection fragments. A second Mettaben take (ancient_mother_im_coming_home.mp3) is available for cross-checking. Awaiting verification against the hymnal notation (Singing the Journey #1069).
